capabilities: Update managed plugins manually or automatically
Read private release assets with linked credentials
Roll back failed installations and preserve code backups
disambiguation: Not a vault sync or backup tool; it installs and updates plugin releases from GitHub.
extras: Not yet in the community directory; manual installation is required until approval. Uses capability-checked internal Obsidian APIs, so compatibility depends on Obsidian exposing plugin lifecycle methods.
problem: Obsidian's community plugin browser does not install or update plugins hosted only on GitHub, especially private repositories.

relations.evidence: Install and update Obsidian plugins from public or private GitHub Releases

summary: Plugin installer and updater that fetches Obsidian plugin releases from public or private GitHub repositories using SecretStorage credentials.
